requirement_text: The FTSS shall notify the application on the ICP, via an API call, 2 minor frames prior to an alignment.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS shall [SRS295] notify the application on the ICP, via an API call, 2 minor frames prior to an alignment.
user_story: As an application developer, I want the FTSS to notify the application on the ICP through an API call 2 minor frames before an alignment, so that my application can prepare.
technical_task: Send an API call notification to the application on the ICP 2 minor frames before each alignment.
acceptance_criteria: Given an alignment is scheduled, when 2 minor frames remain before it, then the FTSS notifies the application on the ICP through an API call.
Given more than 2 minor frames remain before an alignment, when the FTSS checks, then it has not yet sent the notification.

requirement_text: The system shall be designed for high performance with optimized server queries, instantaneous screen transitions, and sub-second cost-division computation.
rationale: "High performance" and "instantaneous" are not measurable and only the cost-division computation has a rough limit.
clarification_questions: What response times count as "high performance", "instantaneous" and "sub-second" for each operation?
Which server queries are to be optimized?

requirement_text: The service shall be able to show the seating arrangement and available seats, allowing users to book the desired number of seats.
user_story: As a customer, I want to see the seating arrangement and available seats and book the number of seats I want, so that I can choose where to sit.
technical_task: Show the seating arrangement with available seats and let users book a chosen number of seats.
acceptance_criteria: Given a service with seating, when the user opens it, then the seating arrangement and available seats are shown.
Given available seats, when the user books the desired number of seats, then those seats are booked.

requirement_text: The solution should allow an authorized user to flag a medication as "Do not substitute" e.g. substitution never allowed for the no sugar or no alcohol mouthwash.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should allow an authorized user to flag a medication as "Do not substitute"  e.g. substitution never allowed for  the no sugar or no alcohol mouthwash.
user_story: As a pharmacist, I want to flag a medication as "Do not substitute", so that substitution is never allowed for it.
technical_task: Let an authorized user mark a medication as "Do not substitute" and block substitution for flagged medications.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized user, when the user flags a medication as "Do not substitute", then the flag is saved.
Given a medication flagged "Do not substitute", when a substitution is attempted, then it is not allowed.
rationale: Role assumed: pharmacist; the requirement says authorized user. The no sugar or no alcohol mouthwash is an example.

requirement_text: The FAU class ensures security-relevant events are logged and identifies what information should be included in those logs.
rationale: The sentence refers to "the FAU class" and states no concrete behaviour.
clarification_questions: What must the system log, and which information must each log entry include?
Is the FAU class a reference to another standard?

requirement_text: The probability threshold for an azimuthal side lobe detection may be higher than for the determination of the signal DTR_Obj_X_LongFusion_Qual / DTR_Obj_X_LongFunc_Qual to enable a pedestrian detection in connection with camera fusion at an early stage.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the probability threshold for azimuthal side lobe detection to be allowed higher than that for DTR_Obj_X_LongFusion_Qual and DTR_Obj_X_LongFunc_Qual, so that pedestrians are detected early with camera fusion.
technical_task: Allow a higher probability threshold for azimuthal side lobe detection than for determining DTR_Obj_X_LongFusion_Qual and DTR_Obj_X_LongFunc_Qual, to enable early pedestrian detection with camera fusion.
acceptance_criteria: Given azimuthal side lobe detection, when its probability threshold is set, then it may be higher than the threshold for determining the signals DTR_Obj_X_LongFusion_Qual and DTR_Obj_X_LongFunc_Qual.
Given camera fusion, when the higher threshold is used, then pedestrian detection is enabled at an early stage.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer. "May" makes the higher threshold permitted, not mandatory.

requirement_text: Hint: A monitoring of SNA, DEFAULT values or OutOfRange of the operating parameters is only present as long as no values could be stored successfully in the NVM.
rationale: The sentence is labelled "Hint" and describes when monitoring exists without a behaviour to implement.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or only a hint?
What must the system do when values cannot be stored in the NVM?

requirement_text: The system shall provide a social messaging platform where users can create and manage groups with chat functionalities.
user_story: As a user, I want a social messaging platform where I can create and manage groups with chat, so that I can talk with several people.
technical_task: Build a social messaging platform with group creation, group management and chat.
acceptance_criteria: Given the platform, when a user creates a group, then the group is created.
Given a group, when members use chat, then their messages are shown to the group.

requirement_text: User shall access fallback mechanisms in situations where offline resources are unavailable, assisting in understanding foreign language content.
user_story: As a user reading foreign language content, I want fallback mechanisms when offline resources are unavailable, so that I can still understand the content.
technical_task: Provide fallback mechanisms that are used when offline resources are unavailable to help the user understand foreign language content.
acceptance_criteria: Given offline resources are unavailable, when the user views foreign language content, then a fallback mechanism is offered.
Given a fallback mechanism, when the user uses it, then it assists in understanding the foreign language content.
rationale: Role assumed: user reading foreign language content. The fallback mechanisms are not described.

requirement_text: If the validation succeeds, user shall be redirected to the "Password reset" page.
user_story: As a user, I want to be taken to the Password reset page after my validation succeeds, so that I can set a new password.
technical_task: Redirect the user to the "Password reset" page when validation succeeds.
acceptance_criteria: Given validation succeeds, when it completes, then the user is redirected to the "Password reset" page.
Given validation fails, when it completes, then the user is not redirected to the "Password reset" page.

requirement_text: The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests. This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2. The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests.  This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2.  The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.'
user_story: As an operations manager, I want the product to handle up to 1 000 concurrent requests, rising to 2 000 by Release 2, including peak scheduling times, so that busy periods are covered.
technical_task: Support up to 1 000 concurrent requests, increasing to 2 000 by Release 2, including at peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon.
acceptance_criteria: Given up to 1 000 concurrent requests, when they are submitted, then the product handles them.
Given Release 2, when 2 000 concurrent requests are submitted at a peak scheduling time such as early morning or late afternoon, then the product handles them.

requirement_text: The fault is intended to detect the signal being in a range between its possible logical states open and closed.
rationale: The sentence says what a fault is intended to detect, without a required behaviour or the signal's name.
clarification_questions: What must the system do when the signal is between open and closed?
Which fault and which signal are meant?

requirement_text: The details of the circuit design and their dimensions shall be coordinated with the client.
user_story: As a client, I want the circuit design details and dimensions coordinated with me, so that I agree to them.
technical_task: Coordinate the details of the circuit design and their dimensions with the client.
acceptance_criteria: Given the circuit design details and dimensions, when they are prepared, then they are coordinated with the client.
Given coordinated details, when the design proceeds, then the client has agreed to them.
rationale: Role assumed: client. The form of coordination is not described.

requirement_text: Only IT team members can access and maintain database servers locally.
user_story: As an IT manager, I want only IT team members to access and maintain database servers locally, so that servers are protected.
technical_task: Restrict local access to and maintenance of the database servers to IT team members.
acceptance_criteria: Given an IT team member, when the member accesses a database server locally, then access is granted.
Given a person who is not an IT team member, when the person tries local access, then access is denied.

requirement_text: The system shall be secure and protect scanned documents from unauthorized access using encryption and access controls.
user_story: As a user, I want scanned documents protected from unauthorized access with encryption and access controls, so that my documents are private.
technical_task: Encrypt scanned documents and apply access controls to them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scanned document, when it is stored, then it is encrypted.
Given a user without access rights, when the user tries to open a scanned document, then access is denied.

requirement_text: The flight NE shall be designed to be capable of complying with all the performance requirements specified herein while non-operating in an atmosphere of 8 to 18 Psia.
requirement_text_raw: The flight NE shall (3.2.3.1.3.6.1) be designed to be capable of complying with all the performance requirements specified herein while non-operating in an atmosphere of 8 to 18 Psia.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the flight NE to comply with all performance requirements after non-operating exposure to an atmosphere of 8 to 18 Psia, so that it survives storage and transport.
technical_task: Design the flight NE to meet all performance requirements after being non-operating in an atmosphere of 8 to 18 Psia.
acceptance_criteria: Given the flight NE has been non-operating at 8 Psia, when it is tested, then it complies with the performance requirements.
Given the flight NE has been non-operating at 18 Psia, when it is tested, then it complies with the performance requirements.

requirement_text: An API User shall be able to persistently store visualization states.
user_story: As an API user, I want to store visualization states persistently, so that I can restore them later.
technical_task: Offer an API function that saves a visualization state so that it persists.
acceptance_criteria: Given a visualization state, when the API user stores it, then it is saved persistently.
Given a stored visualization state, when the system restarts, then the state is still available.

requirement_text: System shall keep session track of user activity.
user_story: As an administrator, I want the system to keep track of user activity in sessions, so that I can see what users did.
technical_task: Record user activity for each session.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user session, when the user acts, then the activity is recorded for that session.
Given a recorded session, when an administrator reviews it, then the user's activity is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. What activity is tracked is not specified.

requirement_text: Dean shall be able to view details of all users (students, faculty, etc.).
user_story: As a dean, I want to view the details of all users such as students and faculty, so that I can oversee the institution.
technical_task: Let the dean see the details of every user, including students and faculty.
acceptance_criteria: Given the dean, when the dean opens the user list, then the details of all users are shown.
Given a user who is not the dean, when the user tries to open the full user details, then access is denied.
rationale: Role stated: dean. The second criterion follows from "Dean shall".

requirement_text: The variable oil pressure control valve is a proportional valve which can set every position from fully open to fully closed.
rationale: The sentence describes a valve and states no behaviour to implement.
clarification_questions: Is this a description of a component or a requirement?
What must the system do with the oil pressure control valve?

requirement_text: System shall facilitate easy sponsorship registration and payment.
user_story: As a sponsor, I want to register as a sponsor and pay, so that I can support the event.
technical_task: Provide sponsorship registration with payment.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sponsorship page, when a sponsor registers, then the registration is saved.
Given a registered sponsor, when the sponsor pays, then the payment is recorded.
rationale: Role assumed: sponsor. "Easy" is not measured.

requirement_text: Connections for chats and calls must remain uninterrupted.
user_story: As a user, I want chat and call connections to stay up, so that conversations are not cut off.
technical_task: Keep chat and call connections running without interruption.
acceptance_criteria: Given an active chat or call, when it is in progress, then the connection stays up.
Given a short network disturbance, when it occurs during a chat or call, then the connection is kept or restored without ending the conversation.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Uninterrupted" is read as staying connected; the disturbance criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: Restaurants shall be able to receive orders from customers.
user_story: As a restaurant owner, I want to receive orders from customers, so that I can prepare them.
technical_task: Deliver customer orders to the restaurant.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer places an order, when it is submitted, then the restaurant receives it.
Given several orders, when they are submitted, then the restaurant receives each of them.

requirement_text: System shall allow creation, updating, and deletion of state-specific data elements such as acts, sections, castes, tribes, etc.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to create, update and delete state-specific data elements such as acts, sections, castes and tribes, so that state data stays correct.
technical_task: Provide create, update and delete functions for state-specific data elements, including acts, sections, castes and tribes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a state-specific data element, when the administrator creates it, then it is saved.
Given an existing state-specific data element, when the administrator updates or deletes it, then the change is applied.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. "Etc." means other elements may exist.

requirement_text: User shall have a managed backup protocol for the Neurohub system as a system administrator.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want a managed backup protocol for the Neurohub system, so that data can be recovered.
technical_task: Define and operate a managed backup protocol for Neurohub.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Neurohub system, when backups are due, then the managed backup protocol is followed.
Given a backup made by the protocol, when it is checked, then it can be used to recover the Neurohub data.

requirement_text: Admin shall update the timing of bus arrival and departure, as well as its location.
user_story: As an admin, I want to update the arrival and departure times and the location of buses, so that passengers see current information.
technical_task: Provide admin functions to update bus arrival times, departure times and locations.
acceptance_criteria: Given a bus, when the admin updates its arrival or departure time, then the new time is saved.
Given a bus, when the admin updates its location, then the new location is saved.

requirement_text: User shall have the option to attach files to emails, with a file size limit of 25 MB.
user_story: As an email user, I want to attach files to emails with a size limit of 25 MB, so that I can send documents.
technical_task: Allow attachments to emails and limit the file size to 25 MB.
acceptance_criteria: Given an email, when the user attaches a file of 25 MB or less, then the file is attached.
Given an email, when the user attaches a file larger than 25 MB, then the file is refused.

requirement_text: User shall be able to search for restaurants by price range (minimum and maximum) with results displayed in a list view by default.
user_story: As a diner, I want to search for restaurants by minimum and maximum price, with results in a list by default, so that I find places in my budget.
technical_task: Add a price range search with a minimum and a maximum and show the results in a list view by default.
acceptance_criteria: Given a minimum and a maximum price, when the user searches, then restaurants within the range are shown.
Given search results, when they are displayed without changing the view, then they appear in a list view.

requirement_text: There shall be a network connection between SwRI and NISN.
user_story: As a network engineer, I want a network connection between SwRI and NISN, so that the two sites can exchange data.
technical_task: Establish a network connection between SwRI and NISN.
acceptance_criteria: Given SwRI and NISN, when the connection is set up, then a network connection exists between them.
Given the connection, when data is sent from one site, then the other site receives it.

requirement_text: System shall generate logs of user bank account details, account updates with date, time, and changes, and fixed asset schedules.
user_story: As an accountant, I want logs of user bank account details, account updates with date, time and changes, and fixed asset schedules, so that financial activity can be traced.
technical_task: Generate logs for user bank account details, for account updates (date, time and changes) and for fixed asset schedules.
acceptance_criteria: Given user bank account details, when they are used or changed, then a log is generated.
Given an account update, when it is made, then a log records the date, time and changes.
rationale: Role assumed: accountant. Fixed asset schedules are logged as stated.

requirement_text: Only collision estimators shall search for recycled parts.
user_story: As a claims manager, I want only collision estimators to search for recycled parts, so that searches are limited to the right role.
technical_task: Restrict recycled parts search to collision estimators.
acceptance_criteria: Given a collision estimator, when the estimator searches for recycled parts, then the search is performed.
Given a user who is not a collision estimator, when the user tries to search for recycled parts, then the search is refused.

requirement_text: System shall enforce business rules, allowing blog owners to manage only their own blogs and not interfere with others'.
user_story: As a blog owner, I want to manage only my own blogs and not interfere with others', so that blogs stay separate.
technical_task: Enforce a business rule that blog owners manage only blogs they own.
acceptance_criteria: Given a blog owner, when the owner manages their own blog, then the action is allowed.
Given a blog owned by someone else, when the blog owner tries to manage it, then the action is refused.

requirement_text: User shall be able to use automated backup scheduling for ensuring data availability.
user_story: As an administrator, I want automated backup scheduling, so that data stays available.
technical_task: Offer scheduling of automated backups.
acceptance_criteria: Given a backup schedule, when the scheduled time arrives, then a backup runs automatically.
Given a completed backup, when it is checked, then the data can be restored from it.

requirement_text: The Technical Owner/Lead shall provide signoff before any [SYSTEM NAME] build can be deployed to the production environment.
rationale: The text contains an unfilled placeholder, "[SYSTEM NAME]".
clarification_questions: What is the actual system name, given "[SYSTEM NAME]" is a placeholder?

requirement_text: The website should cater to all tribes in Nigeria.
requirement_text_raw: The website should cater to all tribes in Nigeria.'
user_story: As a visitor from any tribe, I want the website to cater to all tribes in Nigeria, so that everyone is included.
technical_task: Design the website's content and language to serve all tribes in Nigeria.
acceptance_criteria: Given a visitor from any tribe in Nigeria, when the visitor uses the website, then the content is suitable for the visitor.
Given the website content, when it is reviewed, then it does not exclude any tribe in Nigeria.
rationale: Role assumed: visitor. "Cater to" is not defined, so the criteria are review-based.

requirement_text: Time Management shall provide a utility timer.
requirement_text_raw: Time Management shall (3.3.10.23) provide a utility timer.
user_story: As a software developer, I want Time Management to provide a utility timer, so that I can measure intervals.
technical_task: Offer a utility timer from Time Management.
acceptance_criteria: Given Time Management, when an application requests a utility timer, then a utility timer is provided.
Given a utility timer, when it is used, then it can measure elapsed time.

requirement_text: The number with a '-' in the 'Prv' column indicates the number of insurance companies for which this invoice is awaiting payment.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want a number with a '-' in the Prv column to show how many insurance companies the invoice still awaits payment from, so that I can follow open claims.
technical_task: Show, in the Prv column, a number marked with '-' that counts the insurance companies from which the invoice awaits payment.
acceptance_criteria: Given an invoice awaiting payment from insurance companies, when the Prv column is displayed, then it shows a number with a '-'.
Given the number, when it is read, then it indicates how many insurance companies the invoice awaits payment from.

requirement_text: Users shall be able to check for new software releases and download them manually through the mobile phone.
user_story: As a mobile user, I want to check for new software releases and download them manually on my phone, so that I decide when to update.
technical_task: Provide a check for new software releases and a manual download on mobile phones.
acceptance_criteria: Given the mobile phone, when the user checks for new releases, then available releases are shown.
Given a new release, when the user chooses to download it, then it is downloaded.

requirement_text: Tasks within a rate group shall be executed in the order in which the mission manager registers the tasks.
requirement_text_raw: Tasks within a rate group shall (3.3.4.7) be executed in the order in which the mission manager registers the tasks.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want tasks in a rate group executed in the order the mission manager registers them, so that execution is predictable.
technical_task: Run the tasks of a rate group in the order of their registration by the mission manager.
acceptance_criteria: Given tasks registered in a rate group in a certain order, when the rate group runs, then they execute in that order.
Given a different registration order, when the rate group runs, then the tasks execute in the new order.

requirement_text: Drexel staff's office locations, contact information, and positions will have accuracy greater than 70%.
user_story: As a student, I want Drexel staff's office locations, contact information and positions to be accurate more than 70% of the time, so that I can rely on them.
technical_task: Keep the accuracy of Drexel staff's office locations, contact information and positions above 70%.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sample of staff entries, when office locations, contact information and positions are checked, then more than 70% are accurate.
Given accuracy of 70% or lower, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: If the value of abs (ISPBatVoltFilt1 / ISPBatCurr_A) is equal or higher than PPNM_BCDBatTermMax for longer than PPNM_BCDBatTermDT, then BCDDynRes is set to 200, independent of the actual values of ISPLastValidRdi_mOhm or RdiRevFilt.
user_story: As a battery engineer, I want BCDDynRes set to 200 when the filtered voltage/current ratio stays at or above PPNM_BCDBatTermMax for longer than PPNM_BCDBatTermDT, so that a fixed value is used when the measurement is unreliable.
technical_task: Set BCDDynRes to 200 when abs (ISPBatVoltFilt1 / ISPBatCurr_A) is equal or higher than PPNM_BCDBatTermMax for longer than PPNM_BCDBatTermDT, independent of the actual values of ISPLastValidRdi_mOhm or RdiRevFilt.
acceptance_criteria: Given abs (ISPBatVoltFilt1 / ISPBatCurr_A) is equal or higher than PPNM_BCDBatTermMax for longer than PPNM_BCDBatTermDT, when it is evaluated, then BCDDynRes is set to 200.
Given the same condition, when ISPLastValidRdi_mOhm or RdiRevFilt change, then BCDDynRes is still set to 200.

requirement_text: The Teams app shall be designed for high availability, ensuring minimal disruption in case of individual service outages.
user_story: As a user, I want the Teams app to stay available when individual services fail, so that I can keep working.
technical_task: Design the Teams app for high availability so that an individual service outage causes minimal disruption.
acceptance_criteria: Given an individual service outage, when it occurs, then the Teams app remains available.
Given an individual service outage, when it occurs, then disruption to the user is minimal.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Minimal disruption" is not measured.

requirement_text: User inputs and commands shall be validated to prevent unauthorized access or malicious actions within the system.
user_story: As a security engineer, I want user inputs and commands validated, so that unauthorized access and malicious actions are prevented.
technical_task: Validate every user input and command before it is processed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user input or command, when it is received, then it is validated.
Given a malicious input or command, when it fails validation, then it is rejected.

requirement_text: Interfacing with the courts during the prosecution of cases is an integral part of the responsibilities of police personnel.
requirement_text_raw:
Interfacing with the courts during the prosecution of cases is an integral part of the
responsibilities of police personnel.
rationale: The sentence describes a responsibility of police personnel and states no system behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a statement about police duties?
What must the system do to support interfacing with the courts?

requirement_text: The system shall collect and store user data in accordance with privacy regulations and user consent.
user_story: As a user, I want my data collected and stored according to privacy regulations and my consent, so that my privacy is respected.
technical_task: Collect and store user data only in line with privacy regulations and the user's consent.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has given consent, when data is collected, then it is stored in line with privacy regulations.
Given the user has not given consent, when data collection is attempted, then no data is collected.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The regulations are not named.

requirement_text: After successfully completing IBIT, the software shall continue with the initialization of VxWorks and FTSS software.
requirement_text_raw: After successfully completing IBIT, the software shall (3.3.2.3) continue with the initialization of VxWorks and FTSS software.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the software to continue with the initialization of VxWorks and the FTSS software after IBIT completes successfully, so that startup proceeds in order.
technical_task: After IBIT completes successfully, continue the initialization of VxWorks and FTSS software.
acceptance_criteria: Given IBIT completes successfully, when the software continues, then the initialization of VxWorks proceeds.
Given IBIT completes successfully, when the initialization of VxWorks proceeds, then the initialization of FTSS software follows.

requirement_text: System shall restrict users from viewing other users' details to ensure privacy and security.
user_story: As a user, I want other users unable to view my details, so that my privacy and security are protected.
technical_task: Prevent users from viewing the details of other users.
acceptance_criteria: Given two users, when one tries to view the other's details, then access is denied.
Given a user, when the user opens their own details, then they are shown.

requirement_text: User shall be able to rely on the system's stability and robustness.
rationale: "Stability" and "robustness" are not measurable as written.
clarification_questions: What measurable stability and robustness targets apply (uptime, error rate)?
Which failures must the system withstand?

requirement_text: User shall be able to accommodate a high number of books and users without any faults.
user_story: As a librarian, I want the system to hold a high number of books and users without faults, so that it scales with the library.
technical_task: Ensure the system works correctly with a high number of books and users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a high number of books, when the system is used, then it works without faults.
Given a high number of users, when they use the system, then it works without faults.
rationale: Role assumed: librarian. "High number" is not quantified, so the criteria cannot name a size.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to process inter-faculty transfer requests initiated by authorized users and approved by faculty groups or higher levels.
user_story: As a faculty member, I want to process inter-faculty transfer requests started by authorized users and approved by faculty groups or higher levels, so that transfers are handled properly.
technical_task: Implement processing of inter-faculty transfer requests that authorized users initiate and faculty groups or higher levels approve.
acceptance_criteria: Given an inter-faculty transfer request initiated by an authorized user, when it is submitted, then the system processes it for approval.
Given a transfer request approved by a faculty group or a higher level, when the approval is recorded, then the transfer is completed.
